justifications.type_expressiveness: RomanError is a well-modeled enum with distinct variants carrying relevant data (the offending char, out-of-range value), and the (value, symbol) table is appropriately typed for the small domain.
justifications.error_handling: Typed error enum with meaningfully distinct variants, no panics in library code, and the only unwraps are accompanied by an explicit comment justifying their safety after prior validation.
justifications.api_ergonomics: Narrow public surface with two functions and one error type, sensible derives (Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq), informative Display impl, and doc comments on every public item.
justifications.idiomaticity: Reads like idiomatic Rust: iterator-based encoding loop, ? and checked_add for overflow, matches! in tests, pattern matching on Option, and no unnecessary cloning.
